bad_dedent.message: inconsistent indentation: this line is indented by 2 spaces, which matches no enclosing block
bad_dedent.hint: use one of the indentation levels already open: 0 or 4 spaces

bad_enum_default.message: default 'medium' is not one of the options

duplicate_thing.hint: merge the fields into one `thing` block

empty_one_of.message: `one of` needs at least one option
empty_one_of.hint: e.g. `status: one of draft, sent, paid`

example_before_does.message: this example comes before any `does` block
example_before_does.hint: put examples after the does block they test, or write `example for <does>`

example_missing_expect.message: an example needs an `expect` line after `given`

field_without_type.hint: e.g. `client: text` (types: text, email, number, money (CUR), date, datetime, one of a, b)

missing_app.message: a Loom file must start with `app <Name>`

soft_on_rule.message: `~` soft preferences are not allowed on never/always rules
soft_on_rule.hint: rules are hard constraints; move the preference to a step

tab_indent.hint: indent with spaces (2 per level is the convention)

unterminated_exact.hint: close it with `}` on its own line, lined up with `exact`
